_help: Add a model: copy an entry, give it a new key and name, point path at its best.pt. {PROJECT} = the project folder. Scores are from eval_test.py (test_map50, test_map) and cross_dataset_eval.py + qc_app (cross_map50).

models.name: 1. Baseline YOLO26n (leaky split)
models.test_note: old test set, partly inflated by leakage
models.note: First model, trained on the original Roboflow split. Its test set contained near-copies of training images.

models.name: 2. Leak-free YOLO26n (duplicates removed)
models.note: Exact duplicates removed. Two classes still had no training images.

models.name: 3. Final YOLO26n (grouped split, 66 classes)
models.note: Leak-free grouped split. Fastest model: 1.9 ms per image. Deployed model.

models.name: 4. YOLO26s (3.8x bigger)
models.note: Same data, larger network. 3.6 ms per image.

models.name: 5. YOLO26n + 3,991 Open Images photos
models.note: Data-scaling experiment: same overall score; helped microwaves and ovens, hurt TVs and stoves.

models.name: 7. YOLO26n + Bangladeshi photos (works at a new site)
models.note: Fine-tuned with 1,334 photos from an independent dataset. Other-dataset score 0.50 to 0.92; own test 0.812 to 0.806.
